reviews.title: Great value for the money
reviews.comment: Definitely worth the money to buy this each year instead of letting your current product auto renew.  Most people have smartphones with a calender add when you plan is set to expire and then head to Amazon and shop for a new plan and save yourself some money.
reviews.author: Tim Antosh

reviews.title: McAfee Total Protection Caused Critical Failure on MacBook Pro
reviews.comment: I installed  on my daughter’s Apple MacBook Pro, and shortly after the installation, the system experienced a critical failure that made the hard drive inaccessible. I spent several hours working with McAfee Tier 1 and Tier 2 support, following all recommended troubleshooting steps. Unfortunately, none of those steps resolved the issue. Per their guidance, I took the device to an Apple Store, where I was ultimately told the drive could not be recovered. This was extremely frustrating—not only because of the data loss, but also due to the amount of time spent trying to resolve the problem through support channels without success. Based on my experience, I would strongly urge others to proceed with caution when installing this software on a Mac.
reviews.author: Steve Perez
